newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 edges higher despite CEZ H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 edges higher despite CEZ H1 results.

text.p: The Czech PX50 managed a small gain, 0.14 percent to 509.3, on Friday as CEZ recovered from early losses after it posted sharply lower first half 1997 net profits.

CEZ's after tax profit fell to 3.53 billion crowns compared with 5.95 billion in the same period last year. CEZ recovered to close unchanged on 918 but analysts said the prospects for the company were not good.
"CEZ's results once again showed why investors should stay clear of this electricity company," said a report by ABN AMRO Hoare Govett.

"After the recently published economic results of our biggest banking institutions, we can see that energy company CEZ is another whose half year results are negatively influenced by the continuing stagnation of the Czech economy," said Patrik Brom of Prague International Securities.
Komercni Banka which on Thursday published its own, equally disappointing, results managed a small rebound. Komercni rose 14 crowns to 1,635. Ceska Sporitelna gained one crown to 264.
